A friend sends it on a 'diamond-pulse pulse 🔶' reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'orange coded 🔶' list thread. The orange fill cue is what makes the emoji feel orange coded — it is not just 'shape,' it is 'orange coded diamond-shape moment.'

It is saying 'orange coded diamond-shape,' which carries a specific design-coded tradition. That is why 🔶 travels especially well on partner list-bullet markers, list-marker reveals, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with orange energy.
